The '''Zyluria system''' was located in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Carsanza system/Legends|Carsanza system]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zyluria]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Zylurian]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zyluria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] and released in [[2009]], which placed the system in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
